enemies: Able to survive multiple pirates (level 57) attacking you
rewards: Access to Cave Horrors and the ability to receive them as a Slayer Task.
Charter Ship prices are now halved.
Ability to play the Trouble Brewing minigame.

st.t: Talk to Bill Teach in The Green Ghost inn in Port Phasmatys.
s: Yes, I've always wanted to be a pirate!
Yes, I am a woman of my word.
Yes, I am a man of my word.

st.t: Go to the Port Phasmatys docks, board the easternmost ship and talk to Bill Teach.
Climb down the ladder into the ship's hull and search the repair locker for 4 ropes.
Search the gun locker for 1 fuse.
Pick up the tinderbox nearby.
Go up to the deck.
Climb the climbing net.
Use a rope on the hoisted sail.
Use the fuse on the pirate's powder barrel.
Use the tinderbox on the fuse.
Climb the climbing net.
Use a rope on the hoisted sail.
Talk to Bill Teach.
Enter the ship's hull.
Search the repair locker for repair items.
Repair one of the 3 holes in the hull: use a repair plank on it with a hammer in your inventory. Each hole takes 2 planks and 10 tacks.
Waterproof the hole you just repaired with swamp paste. Then repair and waterproof the next hole the same way, until all 3 holes are done.
Go up to the deck.
Talk to Bill Teach.
Climb the climbing net.
Use a rope on the hoisted sail.
Enter the ship's hull to loot it.
Plunder the chest, loot the crate and ransack the barrel for 10 plunder. Switch world after looting to make plunder respawn instantly.

Climb out of the pirate ship's hull. If you have no rope, pick up the one on the pirate ship's deck. Climb the climbing net and use a rope on the hoisted sail to swing back to Bill's ship, then climb down into Bill's hull.
Add the plunder to the plunder storage.
Go up to the deck.
Talk to Bill Teach.
Climb down the ladder into the ship's hull and search the gun locker for a cannon barrel.
Go up to the deck and repair the cannon.
Repair the cannon.
Talk to Bill Teach.
Climb down the ladder into the ship's hull and search the gun locker for a ram rod, 3 fuses, and canisters.
Go up to the deck to fire the cannon.
Get some gunpowder from the barrel next to the cannon.
Use the gunpowder on the cannon.
Use the ramrod on the cannon.
Use the canister on the cannon.
Use the fuse on the cannon.
Fire the cannon!

After each shot, use the ramrod on the cannon to clean it. Then load and fire again: gunpowder, ramrod, canister, fuse, tinderbox. Repeat 3-4 times, until you're told to stop. If the cannon breaks, get a new barrel from the gun locker and repair it. If you loaded it wrongly, long-press the cannon, choose Empty-Out Cannon, then clean it with the ramrod before you load it again.
Talk to Bill Teach.
Climb down the ladder into the ship's hull.
Search the gun locker for a ram rod, 3 fuses, and cannon balls.
Go up to the deck to fire the cannon.
Get some gunpowder.
Use the gunpowder on the cannon.
Use the ramrod on the cannon.
Use the cannon ball on the cannon.
Use the fuse on the cannon.
Fire the cannon!

After each shot, use the ramrod on the cannon to clean it. Then load and fire again: gunpowder, ramrod, cannon ball, fuse, tinderbox. Keep firing until you've hit the enemy ship 3 times and Bill tells you to stop. If the cannon breaks, get a new barrel from the gun locker and repair it. If you loaded it wrongly, long-press the cannon, choose Empty-Out Cannon, then clean it with the ramrod before you load it again. Quest completed!
